derivation_or_objection: The literal proof uses the span of the first j right singular vectors. For j>n that span does not exist. The identity is nevertheless true because s_j(T)=0 and B=T has rank <=n<j, so the minimum is 0.
checks_performed: Explicit rectangular boundary case m>n, j=n+1; then general j>n. Rechecked every downstream use and found all use nontrivial j within the column range.
downstream_impact: No downstream theorem impact; local proof-completeness repair only.
independence_note: Derived in B14 before reading fleet02/B11 r14; later independently corroborated there.
